description: This file provides hardware information functions for NRF microcontrollers, including device ID retrieval and reset cause handling.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_device_id
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID and copies it into the provided buffer, returning the length copied.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_reset_cause
methods.description: Gets the reset cause flags based on the reset reason register, if not on QEMU Cortex M0.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_supported_reset_cause
methods.description: Returns the supported reset cause flags.
